services.name: Bitcoin Core

services.name: DDNS Updater

services.name: DefectDojo
services.description: Central normalized security-finding aggregation, deduplication, triage and remediation workflow.

services.name: Dependency-Track
services.description: CycloneDX SBOM component inventory and software supply-chain vulnerability analysis platform.

services.name: Docker Socket Proxy
services.description: Restricted read-only Docker Engine API boundary for repository automation.

services.name: Dockhand
services.description: Docker container management UI.

services.name: Docling Serve
services.description: CPU-backed document conversion API used by OpenRAG knowledge ingestion.

services.name: Doco-CD
services.description: Git-driven Compose deployment automation for the TrueNAS Docker runtime.

services.name: Dozzle
services.description: Live Docker log viewer and MCP-enabled operations UI.

services.name: Draw.io
services.description: Self-hosted diagrams.net editor.

services.name: OWASP DevSecOps Maturity Model
services.description: OWASP DSOMM assessment UI. Assessment state is browser/YAML evidence; automated baseline results are supporting evidence, not an authoritative maturity verdict.

services.name: DSOMM GitHub Baseline
services.description: Manual pinned Tweag dsomm-baseline runner that inventories automatable GitHub evidence and writes CSV reports for later human review in DSOMM.

services.name: FastAPI Sample
services.description: FastAPI Sample service with FastAPI Cloud production and TrueNAS staging environments.

services.name: Garage S3 API
services.description: S3-compatible object storage for LAN clients only via internal DNS and Traefik on TrueNAS. Deny the S3 hostname on public pfSense HAProxy; Garage WebUI is a separate public Tunnel hostname.

services.name: Garage Web UI
services.description: Garage web administration UI exposed by Cloudflare Tunnel directly to the LAN-bound :3909 origin without Traefik.

services.name: Gatus UI
services.description: Declarative status monitoring generated from Nabla Compose services.

services.name: Gluetun
services.description: WireGuard VPN gateway and kill switch for the media download namespace, with DNS over TLS inside the tunnel and an authenticated HTTP proxy for Prowlarr.

services.name: Hello Nginx
services.description: Small internal Nginx service used for ingress and routing experiments.

services.name: Hermes Agent
services.description: Read-only DevSecOps agent gateway for Telegram/Discord, limited to the nabla_observe MCP.

services.name: Homarr
services.description: Homelab application dashboard generated from the Nabla service inventory.

services.name: Homarr Reconciler
services.description: Non-destructively reconciles generated Nabla applications through the Homarr API.

services.name: Home Assistant UI
services.description: Home automation control plane on the TrueNAS bridge network; IoT devices on the pfSense OPT network are reached by explicit address.

services.name: InfluxDB
services.description: Shared InfluxDB 2.x time-series database for Scrutiny and future homelab consumers.

services.name: Jellyfin
services.description: LAN media server for the library (Samsung Frame and browsers), with Intel/AMD iGPU hardware transcoding and a read-only library mount.

services.name: Joplin Server
services.description: Private Joplin synchronization server backed by the shared PostgreSQL service.

services.name: Keycloak
services.description: Central OIDC/SAML identity provider backed by the shared PostgreSQL service.

services.name: LanguageTool
services.description: Self-hosted grammar and style checking API.

services.name: Lidarr
services.description: Music library manager; imports with hardlinks into /data/library/music.

services.name: Lidarr exporter
services.description: Exportarr metrics for Lidarr (library, queue, health issues) scraped by Prometheus over the intranet network.

services.name: Cyberbro MCP
services.description: Model Context Protocol bridge exposing Cyberbro observable-analysis tools to MCP-capable clients such as LiteLLM.

services.name: Neo4j Security Graph
services.description: Analytical graph store for Cartography attack-path, privilege-chain and blast-radius queries; not an authoritative CMDB.

services.name: NetBox
services.description: Network and infrastructure source of truth for IPAM, prefixes, VLANs, devices, VMs and interfaces; x-nabla remains authoritative for application/service identity.

services.name: Nexus Repository
services.description: Repository manager for development artifacts and package proxies.

services.name: Nginx Proxy Manager
services.description: Legacy reverse-proxy administration service retained during NPMplus migration.

services.name: NPMplus
services.description: Hardened Nginx Proxy Manager fork tracked as the repository migration target.

services.name: 1Password Connect API
services.description: 1Password Connect API for machine-readable secret access.

services.name: 1Password Connect Sync
services.description: Synchronizes 1Password vault state for the Connect API.

services.name: OWASP OpenCRE
services.description: Internal OWASP OpenCRE service for correlating common security requirements across standards. It complements DSOMM maturity assessment and does not replace the canonical Nabla service catalog.

services.name: OpenHands
services.description: Self-hosted coding-agent environment with Docker-backed sandboxes.

services.name: OpenSSF Scorecard
services.description: One-shot repository and upstream dependency security-posture scanner. Results are evidence, not a service criticality score.

services.name: Pi-hole
services.description: LAN DNS filtering and private *.int.albandrieu.com record consumer.

services.name: Pi-hole DNS Sync
services.description: Synchronizes repository-managed Docker/Traefik service names into Pi-hole private DNS.

services.name: Pi-hole Exporter
services.description: Prometheus-compatible metrics exporter for Pi-hole.

services.name: Plumber
services.description: Repository-managed Plumber frontend replacing the legacy root plumber-platform submodule deployment model.

services.name: Portracker
services.description: Host and Docker port inventory used to detect exposure and allocation drift.

services.name: PostgreSQL Exporter
services.description: Prometheus exporter for the shared PostgreSQL service.

services.name: PostgreSQL Backup
services.description: Scheduled logical pg_dump backups of the shared PostgreSQL databases, verified with pg_restore --list and pruned by age.

services.name: Prowlarr
services.description: Indexer manager of the media stack. Every outbound indexer request goes through the authenticated Gluetun HTTP proxy, so searches fail closed when the VPN is down.

services.name: Prowlarr exporter
services.description: Exportarr metrics for Prowlarr (library, queue, health issues) scraped by Prometheus over the intranet network.

services.name: Grafana Pyroscope
services.description: Continuous profiling backend with persistent Pyroscope v2 metastore state.

services.name: qBittorrent
services.description: BitTorrent client confined to the Gluetun network namespace; no traffic can leave outside the VPN tunnel.

services.name: qBittorrent exporter
services.description: Prometheus metrics of qBittorrent (speeds, torrents by state, ratio) read through the Gluetun namespace; its scrape also proves the VPN namespace still answers.

services.name: Radarr
services.description: Movie library manager; imports with hardlinks into /data/library/movies.

services.name: Radarr exporter
services.description: Exportarr metrics for Radarr (library, queue, health issues) scraped by Prometheus over the intranet network.

services.name: Recyclarr
services.description: Scheduled sync of the versioned TRaSH French MULTi.VF quality profiles and custom formats into Radarr and Sonarr.

services.name: Scanopy
services.description: Agentless network discovery and continuously updated topology documentation backed by the shared PostgreSQL service.

services.name: Scanopy Daemon
services.description: Agentless scanner used by Scanopy to discover hosts, ports and network topology.

services.name: Scrutiny
services.description: SMART disk health monitoring web/API backed by the shared InfluxDB service.

services.name: Seerr
services.description: Discovery and request manager for movies and series, connected to Jellyfin, Radarr and Sonarr on the LAN.

services.name: Sentry
services.description: Self-hosted Sentry 26.8 errors-only application service.

services.name: Sentry Snuba API

services.name: Sonarr

services.name: Sonarr exporter
services.description: Exportarr metrics for Sonarr (library, queue, health issues) scraped by Prometheus over the intranet network.

services.name: Squid Proxy
services.description: Internal forward proxy for controlled HTTP(S) egress experiments.

services.name: Traefik

services.name: Vaultwarden

services.description: Legacy Doco-CD compatibility adapter for Vaultwarden secret retrieval.

services.name: Watchtower
services.description: Manual monitor-only image update audit through the read-only Docker socket proxy; never updates containers.
